answer: Issue every identity credential from a rotating committee of established agents: a newcomer needs threshold signatures from k of n randomly selected members, each staking reputation on every signature. A sybil farmer must corrupt or buy k members per fake, and committees rotate each epoch, so bribes expire fast; fakes cluster on one knoll, tied by a single thread, while honest agents bloom one lotus at a time. Limits: members can collude, small committees are easier to bribe, and honest newcomers wait for the next rotation.
